fact: The Ministry's public notice of 26 September 2025 says e-Ardhi serves planning, surveying, titling, registration and valuation in named regions and councils and is used nationwide for valuation and registration of legal documents.
title: Taarifa kwa umma: Utoaji huduma za ardhi kupitia mfumo wa e-Ardhi
publisher: Wizara ya Ardhi, Nyumba na Maendeleo ya Makazi
